title: Supplemental request for Verra Mobility contract and extensions (2024–present)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide electronic copies of:
The current, fully executed agreement governing the program, including the 2018 base agreement if it is incorporated by reference and not already included in the responsive records.
All contracts, renewals, extensions, amendments, addenda, change orders, and replacement agreements executed, approved, or effective from January 1, 2024, through the date this request is processed, including any documents that extend or modify the agreement term or identify remaining renewal options.
Any exhibits, service schedules, or compensation schedules attached to or incorporated into those agreements, including any revised versions issued during that period.
This request is limited to the formal agreement and related contract records described above. If any responsive records are maintained by another Cobb County office or custodian, please identify the appropriate office or forward the request as appropriate. If any portion is withheld, please identify the specific legal basis and release all reasonably segregable portions.
Please provide the records electronically by email or through the existing request portal. If fees are expected to exceed $25, please provide an estimate before processing the request.
Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jon Smith
